findings.evidence: dom-1440.json: a.btn-secondary 'Read the docs →' has href '#features'; activating it scrolls to the feature cards, not documentation. The nav 'Docs' link points to '#docs', which has no matching section.
findings.after: Read the docs (real target), or relabel 'See what Relay does' if it stays an in-page link.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context): the name says where it goes and it goes elsewhere.

findings.evidence: Three 'Start free' links exist (hero, Starter card, plus 'Get started' / 'Get started free'); the hero one goes to #pricing, the Starter one to '#'. Same name, different destinations; out of context a screen-reader user cannot tell them apart.
findings.after: aria-describedby the plan name, e.g. aria-label="Start free on Starter plan", and give each a real href.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.4 Link Purpose and 3.2.4 Consistent Identification.

findings.evidence: Icons are Unicode text in div.card-icon (⌁ ◉ ↻ ▤ ⇄ ⚑) with no aria-hidden; screen readers announce them ('electric arrow', 'fisheye', 'clockwise open circle arrow') before each heading.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.1.1 Non-text Content: decorative content must be ignorable by assistive tech.

findings.evidence: The terminal is a div stack with decorative '→', '$', '✓' glyphs and three window dots; it has no role, label or pre/code semantics, so it is read as loose fragments ('right arrow plan dot 4 steps dot…'). The green 'ok'/'done' states are colour plus word, which is fine.
findings.after: , with the prompt glyphs and dots aria-hidden.

findings.evidence: At 375 the Features / Pricing / Docs / Changelog links are removed and there is no menu button: focus.json at 1440 has them, the 375 render shows only Relay, Sign in and Get started. Primary navigation is lost on phones.
findings.before: .nav-links { display: none } under the phone breakpoint, no replacement
findings.after: Add a <button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="nav-links">Menu</button> that reveals the list, or keep the four links in a scrollable row.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.10 Reflow (no loss of functionality at 320px) and 2.4.5 Multiple Ways.

findings.evidence: header, nav and footer landmarks exist but no main (sweep). Additionally there is no skip link: the first focus stop is the brand link, then 6 nav items before content.
findings.after:
Skip to content as first child of body; wrap hero-to-CTA in

findings.evidence: Verified on tile 1440-03: 'forever, up to 100 runs/mo', 'per month, unlimited runs' and the footer 'Privacy · Terms · Security' are dark grey on near-black and visibly faint, consistent with the sweep's #62666d readings (about 3.3-3.6:1). The plan terms are content a buyer needs.

strengths: Focus order in focus.json follows the visual order (nav, hero CTAs, pricing, CTA, footer) with no jumps or off-screen stops.
lang and a descriptive title are set; no motion and no hidden-until-scroll content.
